comparison_policy: Literature/NIST/COD values for benchmark comparison only — never HQIV fit inputs
builder_policy: HQIV geometry/binding/packing/folding modules must not read reference_* fields from this file as inputs or fit targets

tier1_polyols.name: CH3OH
tier1_polyols.reference_citation: NIST WebBook ID C67561: Tfus avg 175.59 K; liquid rho 0.7918 g/cm3 and nD 1.3284 at 20 C (CRC/NIST compilation)
tier1_polyols.notes: Liquid witness at 298 K; solid rho/n morphology-dependent (ice studies 0.64–0.84 g/cm3).

tier1_polyols.name: C3H8O3
tier1_polyols.reference_citation: Glycerol (CID 753): Tfus 291.05 K (NIST); liquid rho 1259 kg/m3 at 298.15 K; n ≈ 1.473 at 20 C (CRC/PubChem)
tier1_polyols.notes: Glass/crystal polymorphism; liquid witness chosen for polyol ladder step.

tier1_sugars.name: C6H12O6_alpha
tier1_sugars.reference_citation: alpha-D-glucose anhydrous: rho 1.5620 g/cm3 at 18 C/4 C (PubChem); Delta_fusH at 414 K (Parks & Thomas 1934, NIST WebBook ID C492626)
tier1_sugars.notes: Solid n not tabulated in NIST WebBook; decomposes on heating past fusion witness.

tier1_sugars.name: C6H12O6_monohydrate
tier1_sugars.reference_citation: alpha-D-glucose monohydrate: rho 1.54 g/cm3 at 25 C/4 C (PubChem); MP ~83 C (dec.) commercial hydrate form
tier1_sugars.notes: Hydrate allotrope; distinct from anhydrous fusion witness at 414 K.

tier1_sugars.name: C12H22O11
tier1_sugars.reference_citation: Sucrose: rho 1.587 g/cm3 (25 C, d425); Tfus 461–462 K with decomposition (Kofler & Sitte 1950, NIST WebBook ID C57501); solid n not standard — 10 wt% solution nD20 = 1.34783 (CRC)
tier1_sugars.notes: Melting witness is decomposition onset; solid refractive index not used.

tier2_peptide_crystal.name: GlyGly
tier2_peptide_crystal.reference_citation: alpha-glycylglycine ambient: Dx 1.516 Mg/m3, space group P21/c (Moggach et al., Acta Cryst. B62, 310, 2006); MP 262–264 C dec. (Fisher Scientific product spec, CAS 556-50-3)
tier2_peptide_crystal.notes: Structure ID COD 2100438 series; zwitterionic crystal, sequence GG.

tier2_peptide_geometry.name: N_CA
tier2_peptide_geometry.reference_citation: Engh RA, Huber R. Acta Cryst. 1999; D55:383-393 (peptide restraints)
tier2_peptide_geometry.notes: High-resolution protein crystallography average; not an HQIV input.

tier2_peptide_geometry.name: CA_C
tier2_peptide_geometry.reference_citation: Engh RA, Huber R. Acta Cryst. 1999; D55:383-393

tier2_peptide_geometry.name: C_N_peptide
tier2_peptide_geometry.reference_citation: Engh RA, Huber R. Acta Cryst. 1999; D55:383-393

tier2_peptide_geometry.name: C_O
tier2_peptide_geometry.reference_citation: Engh RA, Huber R. Acta Cryst. 1999; D55:383-393

tier2_peptide_geometry.name: phi_alpha
tier2_peptide_geometry.reference_citation: Typical alpha-helix basin centroid near phi=-60, psi=-45 deg (Pauling/Corey/standard biochemistry texts)
tier2_peptide_geometry.notes: Basin centroid for comparison; HQIV rational alpha uses derived phi/psi.

tier3_peptide_fold.name: GG
tier3_peptide_fold.reference_citation: Moggach et al., Acta Cryst. B62, 310 (2006); ambient P21/c structure
tier3_peptide_fold.notes: Extract Cα trace from zwitterionic crystal; 2-residue foundation gate.

tier3_peptide_fold.name: ACE_ALA_NME
tier3_peptide_fold.reference_citation: Ace-Ala-Nme capped dipeptide model geometry (OpenMM wrappers/python/tests/systems/alanine-dipeptide-implicit.pdb); not an experimental crystal — conformational reference only
tier3_peptide_fold.notes: Capped dipeptide; grade backbone internal geometry before tertiary contacts.

tier3_peptide_fold.name: GGG
tier3_peptide_fold.reference_citation: Tripeptide crystal or high-quality model structure not yet pinned
tier3_peptide_fold.notes: Placeholder witness; assign PDB/COD when structure source selected.

tier3_peptide_fold.name: AAAA
tier3_peptide_fold.reference_citation: Four-residue extended control: no tertiary contacts; validates backbone placement before hairpin closure
tier3_peptide_fold.notes: No experimental gold PDB in suite yet; extended phi/psi control.

tier3_peptide_fold.name: trp_cage
tier3_peptide_fold.reference_citation: Neidigh JW et al., PNAS 2008; PDB 1L2Y (Trp-cage miniprotein)
tier3_peptide_fold.notes: Competitive Cα RMSD < 2 Å gate (AlphaFold-class); same bar as every ladder length.
